reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, category_id, launch_date,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY launch_date RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS launched_so_far
FROM products
WHERE category_id IN (1, 13, 17)
  AND launch_date IS NOT NULL
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.launch_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p2
   WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
     AND p2.launch_date <= p.launch_date) AS launched_so_far
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id IN (1, 13, 17)
  AND p.launch_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.launch_date, COUNT(*) AS launched_so_far
FROM products p
JOIN products e ON e.category_id = p.category_id AND e.launch_date <= p.launch_date
WHERE p.category_id IN (1, 13, 17)
  AND p.launch_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category_id, p.launch_date

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.launch_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p2
   WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id

FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id IN (1, 13, 17)

other_way.tradeoff: A subquery counting the category's launches up to that date treats same-day launches alike without a frame, but rereads products.
